findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “But she beat him to the subject”
findings.source_quote: “I mean, jumping around like that in front of the maidens, just like a vain fellow from off the streets!”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “kama mtu mpumbavu wa mitaani” with “kama mtu mwenye majivuno wa mitaani” to preserve the meaning of “vain fellow.”
findings.translation_quote: “Namaanisha, kurukaruka hivyo mbele ya vijakazi, kama mtu mpumbavu wa mitaani!”
